title: Smallest Range II
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, for each index i, modify nums[i] to either nums[i] + k or nums[i] - k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, for each index i, modify nums[i] to either nums[i] + k or nums[i] - k. The score is the difference between the maximum and minimum elements in the modified array. Find the minimum possible score after making these changes.
constraints: Add exactly either k or -k to every value.
hints: After sorting, an optimal assignment has one split: smaller values rise and larger values fall.
Enumerate every split and compute its new extremes.
Any crossed choices can be swapped without increasing the range, yielding a single split.
editorial: Any crossed choices can be swapped without increasing the range, yielding a single split.

tests.explanation: Choose +3,-3,-3 to obtain 4,0,3 and range four.
